title: Seeing Through the Chain: Mitigate Hallucination in Multimodal Reasoning Models via CoT Compression and Contrastive Preference Optimization
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical problem of hallucination in multimodal reasoning models. It uses various benchmarks like AMBER, POPE, and CHAIR to evaluate perceptual accuracy and reasoning faithfulness, but it does not address or evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
